questions.text: Describe a time when you could not use your phone.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you could not use your phone. You should say: when it happened; why you could not use it; what you did instead; and explain how you felt without your phone.

questions.text: Would you like to spend a whole day without your phone?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to spend a whole day without your phone?

questions.text: Why do people find it so hard to put their phones down?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you could not use your phone, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all phones. Why do people find it so hard to put their phones down?

questions.text: At what age should children have their own phone?

questions.text: Have phones made people better or worse at communicating face to face?

questions.text: Why do some people choose to have a break from technology?
questions.say: Now let's talk about living without technology. Why do some people choose to have a break from technology?

questions.text: Could people today live the way their grandparents lived, without modern technology?
